newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to amend native title law - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to amend native title law - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday the government would change the Native Title Act to make it more workable and to allow legitimate development to go ahead.
"We're going to change the Native Title Act if the senate will let the changes through to make it more workable," Howard told Sydney Radio 2UE.

"I think it is ridiculous that all of that money has been spent and no native title has been granted and I think it is also ridiculous that the present native title act is working in a way which prevents some legitimate development from going ahead," he said.
The Native Title Act passed by the former Labor government allows aboriginal groups to claim title on some traditional lands.
Some miners and farmers say it is preventing or delaying mining and other projects from going ahead.
